sinopsis.es: En un momento difícil de su vida personal y profesional, el coreógrafo Florent Mahoukou se enfrenta a sí mismo y a su propio reflejo en una performance filmada en la orilla.
sinopsis.en: At a difficult moment in his personal and professional life, choreographer Florent Mahoukou confronts himself and his own reflection in a performance filmed on the shore.
